title: Road distance from every UAT to each of the 42 court seats
description: The sidecar for a binary matrix the browser reads directly. It exists so the page can re-run the administrative merge and re-assign courts as the reader moves the sliders, without routing in the browser. Rows are court seats in county-code order; columns are UATs in SIRUTA ascending order, the same index the administrative model's own binaries use.

file.description: The binary, alongside this file in the app's data directory.

scaleMetres.description: Stored value times this is metres. 100 keeps the matrix in half the space and moves no assignment.

unreachable.description: Sentinel for a UAT no road reaches from that seat. Must not be mistaken for a distance — reading it as one is how a Delta commune gets handed the first court in the array.

rows.description: Court seats. One per county plus Bucharest.

columns.description: UATs. Must equal the administrative model's uatCount, or the join is silently off by a column.
